subject: orientation/verification-currency
chose: require a clean live working tree as well as matching clean verification provenance for CURRENT
over: treat a matching HEAD as current even after uncommitted changes
because: a verification at the same commit cannot cover later working-tree edits, so commit identity alone would emit a false CURRENT and possibly STEADY

subject: orientation/heading-executability
chose: select SYNTHESIZE only for a parent whose direct children are all terminal
over: move every synthesis obligation below all live work globally
because: parent-local executability removes the ready-sibling deadlock without starving an independently closeable parent; pending synthesis remains visible in the projection

subject: orientation/verification-dirty-exclusion
chose: measure live verification dirtiness with Git while excluding exactly .coherence/status.json
over: reuse the repository-wide gitStamp dirty bit
because: the status write is the receipt being assessed and otherwise self-invalidates every clean run; any other tracked, staged, or untracked change remains uncovered and stale
